mapper.sql: g.id, g.name, g.type, g.component_id, g.protocol_id, g.status, g.transport, g.description, g.create_time, g.update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT , nc.name AS componentName, p.name AS protocolName FROM gateway g LEFT JOIN network_component nc ON g.component_id = nc.id LEFT JOIN protocol p ON g.protocol_id = p.id
AND INSTR(g.name, #{queryForm.name})
AND g.type = #{queryForm.type}
ORDER BY g.id DESC
